verdict.rationale: W&B ships a first-party MCP server and Skills that let AI assistants answer natural-language questions about Weave traces and evaluations. Coding agents using them can also run evaluations and iteration loops. Natural-language operation therefore works, but only through an external agent client such as Claude Code, not through a native natural-language command interface in Weave itself. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, evidence of which Weave operations are controllable by natural language beyond querying and running evaluations, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: connects AI assistants to your Weights & Biases data and documentation so they can answer natural-language questions about your runs, traces, evaluations, and artifacts
Using W&B skills and the MCP server, coding agents like Claude Code connect to Weave. They can read live production data, run evaluations, and execute automatic iteration loops on their own
install Skills so that the agent can work with experiment tracking, tracing, evaluations, and monitoring on its own
